run_build_targets: run selected gRPC build or test targets using the task runner CLI with -b flag
filter_build_targets: filter build targets by label using the -f flag with AND semantics
run_parallel_jobs: run build jobs in parallel across CPU cores using the -j flag
create_build_map: create a mapping of target names and labels to lists of buildable tasks
generate_junit_report: generate a JUnit XML report of build results using report_utils
